name: ios-test-harness
title_zh: 没 Mac 也能在 Actions 里跑起 iOS
tagline_zh: 手上只有 Windows 或 Linux，却要给私有 iOS/KMP 项目出截图和录屏？
tagline_en: No Mac on hand but need screenshots of a private iOS/KMP app? It compiles on a free macOS runner, boots the.
desc_en: Build and RUN an iOS app in GitHub Actions — compile for the simulator, launch it, screenshot/record every screen, and report to Telegram, a GitHub issue, or a secret gist. Use when asked to test an iOS app in CI, get screenshots or video of an iOS app, diagnose which screens crash, compile a private iOS/KMP project on free macOS runners, or when no Mac is available. Repo: oranblock/ios-test-harne
why_zh: 跑完不只给一句通过或失败，而是把每个界面截下来、指出哪一屏崩了，产物直接落到你指定的地方。
why_en: It doesn't just pass or fail: it captures each screen, names the one that crashed, and delivers artifacts where you asked.
limit_zh: 只跑 GitHub Actions 的 macOS runner，本地或别的 CI 用不了；私有仓库要配好签名与密钥。
limit_en: GitHub Actions macOS runners only; needs signing/secrets for private repos, and captures simulator screens, not real-device behavior.
